projection_rules.runtime_projection: read only after its route is reached
Lab-only candidate; never automatic product traffic

actions: Select Renault/Dacia from WMI when available.
Build platform candidates from model/year/powertrain and explicit vehicle facts.
Ambiguity is allowed; use only intersection-safe candidates until stronger evidence arrives.
Attempt passive capture only if adapter/pins/protocol support reliable monitoring.
Otherwise record passive_capture_unavailable.
Do not coerce legacy KWP/ISO, DoIP or CAN-FD research leads into classic CAN routes.
Add trusted-map routes first.
Add exact-platform immutable research routes.
Add broader research routes only as bounded late candidates.
For Zoe Phase 2/Twingo Phase 2, only exact sourced 29-bit tuples are eligible; generic 29-bit enumeration is denied.
Read presence and identity before proprietary candidate DIDs.
Preferred identity records: F187, F18A, F18C, F190, F191, F195, F197.
Read identity twice; stability requires an independent connection before family promotion.
Only if a route answers or refuses, mark route reached and consider its executable scoped candidate DIDs.
Keep every decoder activation=disabled until vehicle_fit=matched.
If all discovery reads are silent or transport_failed, skip candidate DIDs on that route.
Reclassify platform and ECU family after route/identity evidence.
Remove incompatible pending actions.
Add newly applicable exact-platform/family candidates.
Do not repeat reached actions unnecessarily.
Stop on safety threshold, central/brand-reduced budget, user cancellation or informative terminal state.
Stop when expected information gain no longer justifies traffic cost.

priority_model: specificity + source quality + platform fit + ECU-family fit + expected information gain + user value - traffic cost - prior scoped silence - transport uncertainty
brand_specific_priority: exact Zoe/Twingo/Twizy routes after exact platform match
broad Renault routes only after exact candidates
no automatic enhanced Duster headers until response addressing is resolved
